SELECT ck.address, CASE WHEN ck.status = 1 THEN '正常' WHEN ck.status = 2 THEN '迟到' END AS status, ck.risk, DATE_FORMAT(ck.create_time, '%H:%i') AS checkinTime, DATE_FORMAT(ck.date, '%Y年%m月%d日') AS date FROM tb_checkin ck WHERE ck.user_id = #{userId} AND ck.date = CURRENT_DATE
